description: Holds branch review complaint nature records, linked to branch review header.
business_purpose: Used to track and report branch review complaint nature records for the Customer Support area.
record_granularity: One row represents one branch review complaint nature.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the branch review complaint nature.

columns.name: header_id
columns.description: Reference to the branch review header linked to this branch review complaint nature.

columns.name: nature
columns.description: Nature of the branch review complaint nature.

columns.name: sheets
columns.description: Sheets of the branch review complaint nature.

relationships.description: Each branch review complaint nature references one branch review header (header).

business_rules: Columns nature classify the record; check the distinct values before filtering on them.
Join to Branch Review Header through the foreign key columns to resolve names.
common_queries: Branch Review Complaint Nature by branch review header
Branch Review Complaint Nature count by nature

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name BranchReviewComplaintNature (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
Use COUNT(DISTINCT Id) when counting branch review complaint nature records; joins can duplicate rows.
To resolve names, join on: header_id = BranchReviewHeader.Id.
